Congenital glycosylation disorder defined by myopathy, epilepsy and progressive cerebral atrophy; neonatal respiratory distress alone does not establish pulmonary damage.
Cerebellar and cardiac malformations define syndrome; cleft palate and scoliosis/kyphosis each reported in 30-79%. Ocular damage is not established as common.
Defined by impaired bowel evacuation; no other organ damage is intrinsic to the umbrella concept.
Isolated spermatogenic failure causing male infertility; reproductive function lies outside the axes, with no endocrine dysfunction established.
Tumour originates in breast, which has no axis; rare malignant transformation or metastases do not justify additional organs.
Nephrotic syndrome and primary microcephaly in 4/4; developmental delay in 3/4. Skin findings occur in only 1/4.
Inherited mucocutaneous candidiasis with oral thrush and dermatitis in 2/2; blepharitis in 1/2 supports ocular involvement, although the cohort is very small.
Congenital lymphatic vascular hypoplasia causes lymphedema; hyperkeratosis and toenail dysplasia reported in 30-79%. Cellulitis is a separate infection.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with callosal agenesis and seizures; strabismus and cardiac septal abnormalities each reported in 30-79%. Renal anomalies are under 30%.
Inherited age-related sensorineural hearing impairment; disease is confined to the auditory axis.
Defined as inherited erythrocyte metabolic enzyme defects causing hemolytic anemia; no additional organ damage applies commonly across the group.
Inherited bile acid synthesis defect with hepatic fibrosis and failure; iron deficiency anemia is separate, and prolonged clotting time reflects hepatic dysfunction.
Progressive renal tubular atrophy and interstitial fibrosis cause kidney failure; anemia is secondary to renal disease, not direct blood-cell damage.
Adenocarcinoma originates in the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes; urinary tract invasion is not established as common.
Isolated sperm flagellar abnormalities and impaired motility cause male infertility; no nonreproductive organ involvement is established.
Inherited focal epilepsy arising in the temporal lobe; no other organ damage is established.
Neoplasms located in the nervous system; retinal tumours are a minority subtype and do not justify ocular labelling across the umbrella.
Bladder and urethral malformations define the spectrum; abdominal wall defects occur in 30-79%. Gastrointestinal and spinal malformations affect minority subtypes.
HIVEP2 neurodevelopmental disorder; strabismus in 3/6 and hip dysplasia in 2/4 support involvement. Reflux is separately diagnosed; skeletal estimates are small.
Pontocerebellar hypoplasia with severe neurodevelopmental impairment; optic atrophy in 4/8 supports direct ocular damage. Dysphagia reflects neurologic dysfunction.
Combined immunodeficiency defined by deficient T-cell numbers/function; lymphopenia is common. Site-specific infections and hepatitis are reported in fewer than 30%.
Central sleep-wake regulation disorder causing excessive sleepiness and REM-related phenomena; no other organ damage is established.
Vitamin deficiency defined by low circulating 25-hydroxyvitamin D; rickets and osteomalacia are separate diagnoses and not universal consequences.
Alopecia and intellectual disability each occur in 11/11; seizures in 7/11. LSS gene identity alone does not establish a separate metabolic phenotype.
